reader_config.note: Machine-readable patterns the Blueprint Reader app (hydrants.py v0.6+) loads at runtime. Python 're' syntax. Changing these changes reader behaviour; every run records this file's sha256 and the library commit.

not_hydrant_words.meaning: hydro ducts / hydrovac / BC Hydro are never hydrants (R-HYDRO-NOT-HYDRANT)

status_wording.meaning: call-out wording that means status 'tie_in'; v7 (BR11-03): 'TIE EXISTING ... HYDRANT LEAD TO ...' = hydrant-lead tie-in
call-out wording that means status 'new'; v9 (BR17-01): 'INSTALL INSULATION AROUND HYDRANT' is work on an existing hydrant, not new
call-out wording that means status 'existing'; v9 (BR17-01/02): RAISE/LOWER/ADJUST/INSULATE work on a hydrant = existing hydrant with in-scope work

beats.lesson: BR17-04: 'REMOVE AND RELOCATE HYDRANT' is one relocate action

status_precedence.order_note: statuses are evaluated in status_wording order; tie_in first, then existing is dropped if an action status is present, then each 'beats' pair removes the loser

general_note_text.regex: ^\s*\d{1,2}\s*[.)]\s|\bMAY BE\b|\bWHERE\b|\bALL\b.*\bSHALL\b|\bSHALL NOT\b|\bWRITTEN PERMISSION\b|\bNOTIF|\bRETURN ALL\b|\bIN ACCORDANCE\b|\bLOCATIONS? TO BE CONFIRMED ON SITE\b
general_note_text.meaning: numbered notes / spec phrasing -> mention (R-LEGEND-NOT-INSTANCE / general_note_or_spec)

notes_heading.meaning: NOTES/SPECIFICATIONS heading gates the column beneath it (BR02-FP-01)

site_verb.meaning: site-action verbs that keep a label as an instance on typical/coverage gates; v9: RAISE/LOWER/ADJUST/INSULAT(E|ION) added (BR17-01/02)

legend_words.regex: ^(?:WATER\s+\w+|FIRE HYDRANT(?: LEAD)?|HYDRANT(?: & VALVE ASSEMBLY)?|YARD HYDRANT|AIR VALVE|COUPLING|CAPPED END|WATER METER|WATERMAIN(?: ABD)?|SANITARY .*|STORM .*|GATE VALVE)$

profile_hydrant_label.meaning: hydrant profile label used for station pairing (BR03-02)

legend_row_prefix.meaning: v7 (BR12-01): legend rows by layout: a stacked block of >=6 short rows, most starting EX./PR./PROPOSED -> legend even without a LEGEND heading or with status words

hydrant_tag.meaning: v7 (BR07-02): tag-only hydrant label ('HYDRANT #1', 'HYD-05') = hydrant id; v7.1 (run04 non-blind p9 '-HYD-06'): a leading dash/dot leader stub is allowed

typ_marker.meaning: v7 (BR07-02): '(TYP.)' call-out applies to every tagged hydrant on the sheet

detail_title.meaning: v7 (BR11-01): enlarged intersection-detail sheet title; its instances duplicate plan-sheet instances at the same named streets

ocr_seed.meaning: v7 (BR09-01): partial hydrant word in 150 dpi OCR -> re-OCR that region at 300 dpi

general_tie_in.meaning: v8 (BR13-04): general water-main tie-in call-out ('TIE-IN TO EXISTING 150Ø PVC ...'); a tie-in record, not a hydrant instance; requires a water-pipe noun within the same line run (water main/line/service, <size> PVC/AC/DI, TEE) and no other-utility word (manhole, sewer, storm, curb, asphalt, gas) - v8 non-blind run03/05 false positives

spec_list_row.meaning: v8 (BR15-01): specification list row naming a location and hydrant number(s)

spec_scope_statement.meaning: v8 (BR15-01): document scope statement giving the status of listed hydrants

existing_abbrev_label.meaning: v9 (BR18-03): a stand-alone survey label 'HYD.' marks an existing hydrant (reported as existing; scope decided by the grader, out-of-scope existing scored separately); a leading/trailing survey symbol '-O-' / '-+-' is allowed; such a label is never a note or a typical-section reference

standard_reference.meaning: v9 (BR19-01/02): standard-drawing reference used to tie a station-less repeat (profile label / servicing plan) to the stationed plan call-out

hydrant_tee_assembly.meaning: v0.10 (BR20-01): 'TEE & GATE VALVE w/FIRE HYDRANT' / 'TEE w/ FIRE HYDRANT' plan call-out = new hydrant assembly

detail_sheet_title.meaning: detail/standard drawing title ('[DWG-NO-] INSTALLATION OF FIRE HYDRANT') -> never a site hydrant; marks a detail sheet (BR22-04)

project_scope_new_hydrants.meaning: project scope statement that new hydrants are supplied; lets status-less plan call-outs tied to a hydrant symbol resolve to new (BR22-01/05)

scope_notes.note: Existing hydrants drawn outside the work (e.g. Run 04 EX HYD-01..03) are reported as 'existing'; whether they count is not decided. The reader does not filter them. DECIDED: counted, scored separately (see SCOPE-EXISTING-OOS-COUNTED-SEPARATELY).
Counts are per status and never summed.
v7: tie_in is reported per item (tie_in_items), including hydrant-lead tie-ins of existing hydrants.
Existing hydrants outside the construction scope count toward hydrant mastery but are scored separately from in-scope work and never as new installation quantities.

Watermain tie-ins not linked to a hydrant are outside hydrant scope. They may be reported as main_tie_in (hydrant_linked=false) but are not hydrant results; tie-in detection is not widened to general watermain work.

fuzzy_vocabulary.meaning: v7 (BR08-01): garbled text-layer words (PROPOSLD HYDRANI) corrected with low confidence, only on lines that do not already mention a hydrant
